Return 30 rows. Do not output story_points, comment_count or product_page_url.

summary: The cron detected BODEGA at 0% twice and ran a heal on its own — and the heal did not fix it, because nothing on the target had broken. The scraper was returning one wrapped row holding a products array, and the watcher's own payload parser scored the envelope instead of the rows. The fix landed in rowsOf, the next scan read 12 rows at 100%, and the diagnosis recorded here is the false alarm the system believed at the time. The VERIFIED stage and closure were written from the recovery scan's timestamp after the parser fix landed; the detection, diagnosis and re-weave rows are repair.js's own autonomous writes.
